notes.title: AR-K FINAL EPISODE WILL BE RELEASED THIS SUMMER & SALE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6288271/bbfb475390c22ef4080e2539fb7df392bc0af4d9.png[/img]

Hey folks, how are you doing? 

Summer sale is here, time for big deals... and also huge news for the AR-K community! 

We would like to announce the [b]release of the fourth and final installment[/b] of AR-K. This episode will end the saga, and what's even better, AR-K [b]episodes 1 & 2 are being remastered[/b] to match the quality of "AR-K: The Great Escape"! [b]Both, will be released before the end of this summer.[/b] 

To thank you one more time for your patience. In the next few weeks we'll provide you more details, so stay tuned! 

Best regards & happy summer sales, 
The Gato Salvaje team!

notes.title: BULLSHOT RELEASE! EXCLUSIVE 66% LOYALTY DISCOUNT AR-K USERS
notes.content:
Hello, buddies! 

Since this Thursday we have a new member in Gato Salvaje’s family, a shoot ‘em up game called [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/436530]BULLSHOT[/url], which is an AR-K spin-off, came to light. We are gonna celebrate it with a very special and limited time offer only for the ones who already have the old AR-K episodes.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uI3Q29q.jpg[/img]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/436530]BULLSHOT[/url], is a [i]run ‘n gun[/i] retro game where you’ll have to help our friend “Franky the bull”, one of the main characters of AR-K, to annihilate hordes of Cardesians, robots, zombies and many other enemies.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9UFrFXE.jpg[/img] 

So, this is the deal, if you have the old AR-K installments, then [b]you're about to receive an EXCLUSIVE 66% LOYALTY DISCOUNT[/b] for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/368890/]AR-K: The Great Escape[/url]. 

Since we don’t use to release new games very often, this is [u]probably the best chance you’ll get to catch [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/368890/]AR-K: The Great Escape[/url] [/u] in a long time.

If that’s not enough, we remind you that [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/368890/]AR-K: The Great Escape[/url] was one of the most interesting adventure games released in 2015 according to the critics, [url=http://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/ar-k-episode-3-the-great-escape]ranked within the Metacritic Top 100 PC games for 2015[/url].

Don't forget [u]this loyalty discount expires in 7 days, so move fast!![/u]

Kindly,
Gato Salvaje Studio

notes.title: JANUARY 2016 UPDATE: AWARDS, PLANS AND LOYALTY DISCOUNT!
notes.content:
Hey buddies! We have a bunch of good news for you.

Let us say 2015 was a fine year for AR-K! At the same time we are about to reach the milestone of 100.000 units distributed, the third installment of the AR-K saga “The Great Escape” received really good critics, which placed it among the top PC games at Metacritic site. Even more, [b]“AR-K: THE GREAT ESCAPE” was awarded as “GAME OF THE YEAR” and “PC GAME OF THE YEAR”[/b] among the spanish videogames released in 2015 by specialist site [url=http://www.devuego.es/blog/2016/01/11/premios-devuego-2015-ar-k-la-gran-evasion-mejor-videojuego-espanol-de-2015/]DeVuego[/url], and nominee for the best screenplay at [url=http://www.granadagaming.com/granada-gaming-festival-2015-premios-granada-gaming.html]Granada Gaming Fest[/url].

For those reasons we would like to give all the 1st and 2nd  AR-K installment gamers a [b]SPECIAL LOYALTY DISCOUNT[/b] in order to thank your trust with us and check all the improvements that made “AR-K: The Great Escape” as one of the most interesting adventure games released in 2015.

Last but not least, we wanna let you know that we are currently working in the 4th and final AR-K episode, to be released by this spring. And after that we have [b]plans to remodel and improve AR-K 1st and 2nd episodes[/b] with better graphic assets, gameplay and almost all the improvements from the third installment. Of course this will be free for all AR-K users! ;)

Best wishes,
Gato Salvaje

notes.title: Steam interface fix for 64 bit PC!
notes.content:
Hi!

Some of you are suffering issues to use the shift+tab to open the Steam interface. We can not fix it right now through Steam without harm the 32 bit people.

Here is a link to the patch, so you can apply it and fix that issue: 

https://db.tt/kTDQMSUy

I encourage you again to add me to your friends list and tell me all that you don't like about the game, We are a crowdfunding project and we want to grow up with our client's critics.

We want to offer you a full client assistance through Steam, so you can talk with us for anything you want, if you are stuck or simply you want to change something specific in the next chapter.

We are here to help.

Sergio 

http://steamcommunity.com/id/SprietoGato/

notes.title: Exam fix
notes.content:
The last week we fixed the bug that make Alicia lost the cheat sheet during the exam scene.

With the last patch we add a fix for the people that are stuck in that scene because they played before the patch. If you clicked in the "Studious Girl" (under Alicia) you'll have the cheat sheet again in your inventory.



Best!

Sergio

notes.content:

Our first major update is here! We've put a ton of work into improving our game, and we fixed all the known bugs.

Thanks to our costumers for helping us, and sorry for the inconvenience up to this moment!

Remember that you can add me as a friend (http://steamcommunity.com/id/sprietoGato/) to your Steam account if you have any bug, I'll give you a personal attention to solve all the problems you may have found :)


And now we have a Linux version, enjoy it! :D
